name: usha_bgm_bansuri
caption: Emotional dawn devotional instrumental, no vocals. Soft expressive bansuri flute carrying a tender, hopeful melody over a warm tanpura drone, gentle tabla and light manjira, slow build in the middle, a warm shehnai swell at the sunrise moment, peaceful ending with soft temple bells. Indian classical folk fusion, cinematic, heartfelt, serene, uplifting, no electronic sounds, no drops.
